label: For "Digital Twin Calibration for Line Simulation": Calibrate a discrete-event simulation of a production line from real event data so what-if tests on layout, buffers and staffing give trustworthy answers. Define the label exactly as in milestone M1: what counts as a positive or a correct outcome, and when it becomes known. Design around this trap first: Fitting to the training period only.
